name: macro-playful-wink-girl
image_purpose: Profile visual and facial-detail social post

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic extreme close-up UGC macro portrait of an approved adult, preserving the ombre hair, wink, pucker, faux-fur neckline, silver hoops, and bright outdoor background.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult with brunette-to-blonde ombre wavy hair, olive-toned complexion with warm undertones, one hazel-brown eye open and one eye in a deliberate wink, playful puckered expression, natural pores and fine facial lines, minimalist silver hoop earrings, and a deep black high-pile faux-fur neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: Extreme close-up macro portrait with the head tilted about 15 degrees to the right, asymmetrical wink and pucker, face filling the frame, diffuse bright outdoor background bokeh, vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-intensity diffuse natural daylight, gentle shadows around the winking eye and nose, realistic skin sheen, rich burgundy and deep black against warm skin tones.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm macro lens, ISO 100, shallow depth of field, 8K detail, sharp central facial features, unfiltered texture, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 extreme close-up macro portrait of an approved adult with brunette-to-blonde ombre wavy hair and olive-toned skin with warm undertones. One hazel-brown eye is open with defined lashes and the other is in a deliberate wink; she makes a playful puckered expression with natural lip texture and visible pores and fine facial lines. Deep black high-pile faux-fur neckline and minimalist polished silver hoop earrings. Head tilted 15 degrees right, diffuse bright outdoor background bokeh, high-intensity natural daylight, gentle realistic shadows, 85mm macro lens, ISO 100, unfiltered high-fidelity texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, erotic framing, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted face, extra eyes, deformed lips, extra fingers, watermark, invented text
